facts.fact: The UMOA Banking Commission register updated 29 June 2026 lists in Guinea-Bissau one licensed payment institution (INTOUCH GUINEE-BISSAU, EP.GB.001/2025) and one licensed e-money institution (FINANCES MOBILES BISSAU, EME.GB.021/2023), neither a bank.
facts.system: UMOA register of approved institutions (payment and e-money institutions)

facts.fact: The BCEAO list of payment institutions approved in the UMOA at 15 September 2025 shows one in Guinea-Bissau, INTOUCH Guinée-Bissau SARL (EP.GB.001/2025), among 30 in the union.

The BCEAO states that payment institutions in the UMOA, Guinea-Bissau among the eight states, are licensed under its Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services, and 34 were approved at 31 August 2026.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 relative aux services de paiement dans l'UMOA

facts.fact: The BCEAO list at 31 August 2026 shows one payment institution licensed in Guinea-Bissau, INTOUCH Guinée-Bissau (EP.GB.001/2025), approved on 25 June 2025.

iAfrikan reports that the BCEAO required every bank, e-money issuer and payment institution in the eight WAEMU states, Guinea-Bissau included, to connect to its PI-SPI instant payment platform by 30 June 2026, then on 25 June 2026 moved the deadline to 30 September 2026 (microfinance institutions to 30 June 2027).
facts.system: BCEAO deadline to connect to PI-SPI
